summary.text: Atoosa Reaser is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 27, representing part of Loudoun County, serving since January 10, 2024. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Courts of Justice, Education, and General Laws.

paragraphs.text: Atoosa R. Reaser was born in Tehran, Iran, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says she earned a B.A. in modern foreign languages and secondary education from James Madison University and a J.D. from Antonin Scalia Law School, and lists her occupation as lawyer.
The profile lists her memberships as the Virginia State Bar and the Virginia Women Attorneys Association.
